payload.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the image show the background changed into a recognizable basketball court?
node.criteria: Use all support observations. Complete only when the evidence establishes that the background is a recognizable basketball court consistent with the target; do not require any single feature beyond the target. Partial when basketball-related progress is evidenced but the background is not established as a recognizable court. Absent only when evidence establishes that no requested background progress occurred. Unknown when necessary evidence is unavailable, unresolved, or insufficient; do not infer visual facts beyond the supports.
